Annual Review Policy

Every enrolled student receives one formal academic progress review each year. The review is scheduled during October and is led by the student's assigned academic adviser. Before the meeting, the student submits a short reflection covering completed work, current challenges, and goals for the next study period. The adviser discusses the reflection, records agreed actions, and sends the review summary to the student within five working days. The annual review is developmental rather than a final grade. If a student cannot attend the scheduled meeting, the adviser arranges a replacement appointment.

The policy exists to make progress discussions consistent and to identify support needs early. Students may ask for a support person to attend. The programme coordinator monitors whether reviews have been completed, but the assigned adviser remains responsible for conducting the meeting and recording the agreed actions.
